content:
The BUILT CoLAB RDI team has compiled all the work undertaken throughout 2021 and is now presenting it in a single report available for consultation to all stakeholders.

This way we intend to show to the whole AEC sector the developments that the team has been achieving in the work done, both internally and in collaboration with other entities from industry and academia, following its principle of collaboration and co-creation.

You can consult that report here in digital magazine format or here in PDF format.
